english.title: Drop / leave item which caused / might cause damage / defacement of property at Heathrow Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) dropped, left, threw or otherwise deposited **(..SPECIFY ITEM(S)..), where doing so

(A)_[caused, contributed or tended to lead to]_
(B)_[might have caused, contributed or led to]_

(C)_[damage to property, namely **(..SPECIFY PROPERTY..),]_
(D)_[the defacement of property, namely **(..SPECIFY PROPERTY..), by litter, pollution or an improper or unauthorised disposal of waste substance]_

on part of a Restricted Area, namely **(..SPECIFY THE RESTRICTED AREA..), at Heathrow Airport
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 3.22(a) and 2.3 of the Heathrow Airport - London Byelaws, 2014 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
english.pointstoprove:
